postconditions.expression: all(len(dominoes) == n and n % 2 == 0 for n, dominoes in test_cases)
postconditions.description: Each test case contains an even number of dominoes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(chain(*dominoes))) == 2 * n for dominoes in test_cases)
postconditions.description: Each domino contains two unique numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(result == 'YES' or result == 'NO' for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each test case has a valid result of either YES or NO.

invariants.description: Each domino contains exactly two numbers.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= num <= n for num in chain(*test_cases))
invariants.description: Each number on a domino is between 1 and n.
